name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage remodel and paint job?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage remodel and paint job?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reputable contractor provides comprehensive prep, proper trade coordination, and accountable owner oversight. You should confirm whether they handle underlying drywall repair, tape-and-bedding, and primer application, or if they only apply topcoats over existing blemishes. Look for a licensed, BBB-accredited business with positive reviews and an on-site lead who oversees the project. Because garage renovations can involve lighting updates or shelving adjustments alongside painting, choosing a full-service remodeling contractor ensures all finish details are handled under a single point of contact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, accredited contractor who handles drywall repair alongside painting, offers clear written estimates, and provides hands-on job site management.
